description: qestack guard: blocks edits that weaken locked tests, change protected qestack files or forge qestack result files. It does nothing in repositories without .qestack/project.toml. It warns when the qestack engine is not installed.

hooks.command: if command -v qestack >/dev/null 2>&1; then qestack hook; elif [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.qestack/project.toml" ]; then echo '{"systemMessage": "qestack guard is NOT active: the qestack command is not on the PATH of Claude Code."}'; fi
